newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Govt needs to do more on fiscal policy-RBA.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Govt needs to do more on fiscal policy-RBA.

text.p: Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA) governor Ian Macfarlane said on Thursday the government needed to do more on fiscal policy.
"Here in Australia substantial progress has been made, although more needs to be done," Macfarlane told a derivatives conference, referring to the government's fiscal policy.
He said the government had announced it aimed to return the budget to surplus by 1998/99 (July-June) from its current deficit of about 1.75 percent of GDP.
Macfarlane would not elaborate on his comments about fiscal policy when questioned by reporters after his speech.
"No comment," he said when asked if the government should return the budget to surplus before 1998/99.
